title: Luceras Vision Board
heading: Luceras: vision board
lede: Stage 2 of 11, reopened. Six picks are in; the last is the horn shape, now in two sets (7 and 8). Pick one; then Confirm, which notifies the orchestrator.

palette.name: Palette
palette.question: Which coat color and pattern?
judge: Does the pattern read at a glance?
Does it fit sky, cloud and island stone?
Dark above and light below?

recommend.reason: Reads strongest at game size, and dark-above, bright-below is how an animal hides when seen from above against the gaps and from below against the sky.

horns.name: Horns
horns.question: Which horn surface and color?
judge: Ram-like?
Heavy enough to be the strike weapon?
Readable against the ears?

recommend.reason: The most ram-like, and these horns are the creature's strike weapon, so heavy and dark suits them. C is the air-element hint if you want character over realism.

eyes.name: Eyes
eyes.question: Which eyes?
judge: Alert at small size?
Does the pupil shape suit the horns?

recommend.reason: The goat pupil matches the ram horns and reads as alert at small size.

fur.name: Fur
fur.question: Where does the long fur grow?
judge: Is the shag where the sheet shows it, short on the face?
Do the hind legs read as the big mass?

recommend.reason: Long fur on the hind legs underlines what the creature is built around; A is the fullest shag; B is the weakest fit to the record's shaggy fur and is shown for completeness.

plume.name: Tail plume
plume.question: Which plume at the tail tip?
judge: Close to the base plume, as you asked, while still reading as spiked?
Readable at sprite size without stealing from the leap?

recommend.reason: Set 2, made from your note: closest to the base plume with the fur drawn to pointed tips, so it still answers the record's spiked plume without becoming a weapon. B is the calmer flame, C the slimmest brush.

plume.note: Second set. Your note on the first set: closer to the base image, the flame tongues nearest but too dramatic, no spiked ball.

head.name: Horns and ears
head.question: Which head: bigger horns as the focal point, with which ears?
judge: Do the horns now own the head?
Do the ears pair with the horns instead of competing?
Does it still read as a Luceras at sprite size?

recommend.reason: Reads as an ear at sprite size and sits where a bighorn's would, so the horns crown the head without the face going earless. C is the subtler version; D is horns only.

head.note: Added after your note: the rabbit ears and the horns were competing. Every option edits the combined look, so coat, eyes, fur and plume are as you picked them. The record's 'long upright ears' line is amended to match your pick once you confirm.

horns2.name: Horn shape
horns2.question: Which horns: same size, less curl, less bulk?
judge: Still the focal point of the head?
Less bulk at the base without losing the ram read?
Does the curl you want survive a side view at sprite size?

recommend.reason: Closest to your note: the size kept, the spiral opened to about three-quarters of a turn, and slimmer throughout. B goes further toward an ibex sweep; C keeps the full curl and only slims.

horns2.note: First horn refinement. Your note on it: the curve should sit between A and B; set 8 below has the two in-between options. Pick in either set; the later pick wins.

horns3.name: Horn curve, between A and B
horns3.question: Which curve: half a turn, or just over?
judge: Is this the curve you had in mind between the opened spiral and the long sweep?
Still slim, still the focal point?

recommend.reason: A sits squarely between the two you named: a long arc with the tip turning down, half a turn, slim. B curls a little further.

horns3.note: Second horn refinement, from your note 'somewhere between A and B'. This is the second regeneration on the horns; if neither fits, the next step is a sketch-level note from you rather than another reroll.

fold.title: Decided by the pipeline owner
fold.text: Eye color, horn color and coat are independent choices; the model sheet (next stage) combines your picks into one consistent turnaround and a shaved bare-body version. Every option here keeps every must-have from the approved reading. Images were generated on Nick's Codex subscription, 16 images, about 1.4 minutes and 25K Codex tokens each.

fallback: Picks cannot be saved from this view; reply with five letters instead.
compositeEmpty: Composed preview: the orchestrator generates one image with all five picks and it appears here.
confirmed: Picks confirmed; the orchestrator files them.
